subject: Success metrics & cutline — Artemis MAP and acceptance sprint
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the demo last week. I sketched a concise mutual action plan (attached) to align the evaluation sprint with Artemis's goals and procurement milestones. High-level:

- Success metrics: 95% intent classification recall on core clinical intents; average 95th-percentile generation latency < 300ms; token-cost per call target <$0.03 for typical 512-token interactions.
- Exit gates: signoff from product (accuracy), security (SOC2 evidence checklist), and ops (latency/stability smoke-run).
- Acceptance tests: three smoke scenarios (real-world PHI-safe samples), load-profile run (50 concurrent sessions for 1 hour), and regression checks against the provided prompt set.

I attached Artemis_MAP_v3.xlsx — it maps owners, dates, and the minimal artifacts we need for each gate. Proposed timeline: 4-week evaluation starting 2026-01-26, with procurement finalization by 2026-02-23.

Can you confirm stakeholders and whether the 4-week cadence works for you? If procurement needs a different end date we can compress the runbook.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Artemis_MAP_v3.xlsx)

From: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers: stakeholders are myself (product), Miguel Soto (SRE), and procurement (procurement@artemishealth.com). Procurement is aiming to close by early March, so your proposed mid-February procurement date is helpful but optimistic. Two immediate questions:

1) Can the acceptance tests be run inside our VPC (private deployment) or do we need hosted API artifacts? We have strict data-flow rules for test sets that contain de-identified PHI.
2) For the load-profile run — can you provide a short template for the test harness so our SREs can slot it into their CI?

Also, we need a short evidence packet for security (SOC2 scoping) — if you can attach the summary that would speed review.

Emma
Emma Hale | Group PM, Clinical AI
Artemis Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Emma —

Yes — we can run the acceptance tests in a Private deployment (VPC) and provide a turnkey test harness. Attached: evaluation-runbook-templates.pdf (includes a JMeter + locust sample harness, run commands, and expected pass/fail criteria).

Marissa — looping you in to own the runbook coordination and to be the Redwood lead for the load-profile window. Sean — can you confirm the latency SLO instrumentation we'll capture so Artemis has evidence for ops signoff?

Ben
(Attachments: evaluation-runbook-templates.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jan 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Emma —

Nice to meet you over email. For coordination:

- I propose a 3-week sprint instead of 4, with focused objectives to help procurement:
  * Week 1: Baseline verification (functional smoke tests + security evidence handed over)
  * Week 2: Performance window (load-profile + latency SLO capture)
  * Week 3: Regression & signoffs (product accuracy checks + doc handoff)

- Required artifacts per gate are listed in the attached MAP spreadsheet: run logs, SLO CSVs, sample input/output (redacted), and a one-page acceptance summary for exec signoff.

If Artemis can target a compressed acceptance by 2026-02-16, procurement could have everything to finalize by 2026-02-23. Otherwise, we land procurement by early March as Emma noted.

Marissa Cole | Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: Artemis_MAP_v3.xlsx)

From: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 14:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Marissa/Ben —

Compressed timeline is doable if we lock test data and SRE availability this week. Confirming:

- We will run inside our VPC. Miguel (SRE) will provision temporary egress-to-redwood endpoints and a service account.
- Proposed dates: baseline verification week starting 2026-02-02; performance window week starting 2026-02-09; final signoff week starting 2026-02-16.
- Procurement request: one-page security summary (SOC2 scope + retention policy) and an estimated monthly cost for a small Dedicated pool during the pilot.

I'll copy procurement on the next note (procurement@artemishealth.com).

Thanks —
Emma

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hale <emma.hale@artemishealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, procurement@artemishealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance tests — kickoff

Emma/procurement —

Confirmed timeline and next steps:

1) Week of 2026-02-02: baseline verification (Marissa to run smoke tests; Redwood will delivery SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf and a 1-page acceptance template).
2) Week of 2026-02-09: performance window (Redwood provides load harness + collects SLO CSVs).
3) Week of 2026-02-16: final regression and signoffs; exec one-pager due 2026-02-18.

Procurement ask: I'll attach the one-page pricing summary and DocuSign link for the pilot commitment. If procurement prefers a vendor PO instead of DocuSign, we can run that in parallel.

Attaching: Artemis_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf, evaluation-runbook-templates.pdf.

Please reply-all with any redlines to the MAP by EOD 2026-02-04 so we can lock the sprint owners.

Best —
Ben
(Attachments: Artemis_MAP_v3.xlsx; SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf; evaluation-runbook-templates.pdf)
